remarks: Welcome to Linden House. Don't miss the opportunity to own in this well managed and maintained complex with quick access to all Stamford has to offer. This upper level, light filled unit is generously sized with hardwood flooring beneath the wall to wall carpeting. Gas heat, cooking and hot water all included in common charges, and just steps away from public transportation. One assigned parking space included with unit and you may apply for a second reserved space for a monthly fee. Numerous coin/card laundry areas scattered throughout the complex and your own assigned storage space. Why pay exorbitant rental costs when you can own a two bedroom unit? Property is being sold "as-is". BEST AND FINAL OFFERS BY MONDAY, APRIL 27 AT 5 PM.
